q: What emission factor do I use for biodiesel made from used cooking oil?
title: Used cooking oil biodiesel factor
short: CO2 from burning biodiesel is biogenic, so report it outside the scopes. Methane and nitrous oxide from the engine stay in Scope 1. For a blend, only the diesel share counts as fossil CO2. Collection, processing and transport of the oil go in Category 3, and published factors include them.

ol: Split litres into the diesel share and the biodiesel share from the blend ratio.
Diesel share: 2.68 kg CO2 per litre in Scope 1.
Biodiesel share: biogenic CO2 as a separate line.
Add methane and nitrous oxide for all litres.

p: Keep the supplier's declaration that the fuel is from used cooking oil. Without it, use a general biodiesel factor.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
